item.title: Feds investigate alarming near miss between Alaska Airlines jet, FedEx plane at busy Newark airport
item.summary: Federal authorities will investigate a reported close call at Newark airport involving an Alaska Airlines and FedEx aircraft on crossing runways Tuesday night.

item.title: DHS touts 10 straight months of zero illegal aliens released at border as crossings plunge
item.summary: DHS says Border Patrol recorded 10 straight months of zero migrant releases, crediting enforcement-first policies and historically low illegal crossings.

item.title: Five Mexican nationals indicted after massive meth lab bust uncovers enormous quantities of drugs
item.summary: Five Mexican nationals face federal charges after nearly 3,000 pounds of meth and guns were seized from a clandestine lab in Northern California.

item.title: California to change Cesar Chavez Day to Farmworkers Day after sexual abuse scandal
item.summary: California State Assembly Speaker Robert Rivas announced plans to rename Cesar Chavez Day Farmworkers Day after allegations against the labor activist.

item.title: Denmark secretly prepared to blow up Greenland's runways to stop US aircraft: report
item.summary: Denmark disguised a troop deployment to Greenland as a NATO exercise called Arctic Endurance, with soldiers carrying explosives, DR reported, citing 12 high-level sources.

item.title: Nuclear fusion advances, but challenges remain for power grid
item.summary: Nuclear fusion energy could become commercially viable by the early 2030s as scientists work to replicate the sun's power, potentially transforming energy.

item.title: Duke survives stunning halftime deficit to hold off No. 16 seed Siena in March Madness' first round
item.summary: The Siena Saints nearly became the third team in March Madness history to beat a No. 1 seed as a No. 16 seed, but the Duke Blue Devils rallied in the second half to avoid the upset.

item.title: Major city hikes hotel tax to nearly 20% as tourism bosses eye future events
item.summary: Chicago has raised the tourist tax on downtown hotels to 19% to boost tourism marketing efforts. A new district will fund Choose Chicago campaigns and events.

item.title: Juror says Kouri Richins sympathy flipped after trial exposed kids’ book author’s plot to kill husband: report
item.summary: A juror revealed how the jury in Utah author Kouri Richins' murder trial jury went from sympathetic to a unanimous guilty verdict in her husband's fentanyl poisoning death.

item.title: Mamdani moves to sideline NYC police with new safety office under sweeping overhaul
item.summary: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced the new Office of Community Safety Thursday, signaling a shift in a public safety approach from policing to prevention and support programs.
